Repository source selection Unicode manual QA

Wide grapheme
ASCII-A 界 ASCII-B
ASCII-A 日本語 ASCII-B

Drag between the two occupied terminal cells of 界.
Expected clipboard text: 界

Combining grapheme
ASCII-A é ASCII-B

The accented character above is U+0065 LATIN SMALL LETTER E followed by
U+0301 COMBINING ACUTE ACCENT. Select across é and adjacent ASCII text.
The clipboard must keep é together and must not contain only the accent.

Emoji grapheme
ASCII-A 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 ASCII-B
ASCII-A 👍🏽 ASCII-B

The family is joined with U+200D ZERO WIDTH JOINER characters. The thumbs-up
uses a skin-tone modifier. Drag across either emoji from different occupied
terminal cells. The clipboard must contain the complete visible emoji, not an
individual person, joiner-separated fragment, or unmodified thumbs-up.
